name: button-press
title: Button Press
description: Cursor clicks a button: a cursor walks onto a split action button (label, divider, chevron), it darkens on hover, gives on press, spins while pending and lands on a drawn tick. The deploy, publish or send beat of every launch video. Built on cursor-track.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/cursor/button-press?ref=cli — label, pending and done are the three states; width is fixed so the button never reflows. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette. — 77 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
